name: Real-World Hacker News (Desktop 1280×800) Header Navigation Collapse

groundTruth.defect: Top navigation bar expanded with excessive 36px padding and bright red background #dc2626, and all navigation link text is hidden with font-size: 0px.
groundTruth.rootCause: Overridden padding and red background on main header td with font-size: 0px on .pagetop links
groundTruth.suggestedFix: Restore default 2px padding, #ff6600 background, and remove font-size: 0px
